subject: CPPO: Reseller catalog versioning and SKU deprecation plan
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@cloudresell.com>, AWS Partner Sales <aws-psp@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO: Reseller catalog versioning and SKU deprecation plan

Team — putting this thread together to lock a straightforward plan for how CloudResell will surface our new CPPO SKUs in their catalog, and how we handle the deprecation window for legacy SKUs customers are currently using.

Context: CloudResell is ready to activate a private offer for their early customers next month but they need a deterministic mapping and a short deprecation runway so their billing and support stacks don't break. AWS ops also needs a clean SKU mapping for marketplace reporting.

Attached: sku_mapping_v1.csv (proposed mapping), sku_deprecation_timeline.xlsx (draft dates), ppo_merchant_instructions.pdf (how to publish).

Proposed high-level approach (please review):
- Publish new CPPO SKUs in reseller catalog (single namespace) with alias mapping from legacy SKUs.
- 60-day visibility window where both SKUs are accepted for billing, with clear redirects in documentation.
- Automated mapping file (CSV) pushed to reseller weekly; reseller acknowledges by DocuSign for operational readiness.
- AWS needs a final mapping file 10 business days before go-live.

Ask: Ben — can you coordinate the DocuSign and confirm which reseller contact will sign?
Laura — confirm merchant/marketplace checklist items we must complete on the Redwood side.
Monica — can you validate the invoicing flow/entitlement behavior with our billing team and identify any edge cases for multi-entity buys?
Alice/AWS — flag anything I've missed from the reseller or marketplace side.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
(attachment: sku_mapping_v1.csv, sku_deprecation_timeline.xlsx, ppo_merchant_instructions.pdf)

From: Alice Chen <alice@cloudresell.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Sales <aws-psp@amazon.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO: Reseller catalog versioning and SKU deprecation plan

Thanks Rishi — this looks reasonable and thanks for the attachments. A couple quick notes from CloudResell operations: 

1) Customer impact: we have ~40 customers using the legacy SKU family. Most are on annual contracts and won't accept an automatic transition. We will need explicit customer notifications and a soft-accept period where support tickets can be escalated for billing mismatch.

2) Marketplace display: our catalogue automation can surface aliases but we need the canonical SKU and a stable product title for 90 days to avoid downstream UX churn. 60 days might be tight for product display. Can we extend the public display stability to 90 days while still allowing billing acceptance for 60 days?

3) DocuSign: I can sign internally but need someone on your side to confirm the DocuSign recipient email for authorization.

Requested: send the final mapping as a single CSV with columns: legacy_sku, new_sku, effective_date, notes. We'll consume that in our ingestion pipeline.

— Alice
Alice Chen
Head of Marketplace Integrations, CloudResell Ltd
(attachment: none)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@cloudresell.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Apr 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO: Reseller catalog versioning and SKU deprecation plan

Alice — thanks for the clarity. Quick updates from my side: 

- DocuSign: I'll send the signature request today to alice@cloudresell.com. The signer will be the CloudResell Marketplace Ops lead; I'll copy you when the envelope is created.
- Mapping file: attached updated CSV with the exact columns you requested (sku_mapping_v1.csv). I added an "ingest_tag" column for your pipeline if that helps.
- Display stability: we can do 90 days display stability. Operationally we keep billing acceptance to 60 days to limit liability but we'll add an explicit note in the public display to say "legacy SKUs accepted for billing until yyyy-mm-dd".
- HubSpot: I linked the HubSpot deal record here: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/CPPO-3927 — linking sales play and tasks.

Action items (owners):
- Ben: send DocuSign envelope + attach the final CSV (today).
- Laura: confirm marketplace checklist + upload ppo_merchant_instructions.pdf to our publisher portal (by EOD Thu).
- Monica: validate billing acceptance behavior with finance and confirm whether multi-entity invoices require separate merchant accounts (by Fri).

I'll follow up with the DocuSign status.

Ben Carter
Senior Channel Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment: sku_mapping_v1.csv)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice@cloudresell.com>, AWS Partner Sales <aws-psp@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2026 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO: Reseller catalog versioning and SKU deprecation plan

Following up with a concise status and next steps after internal checks. Quoting Ben's message below for context.

Status summary:
- Merchant checklist: completed except for final marketplace listing screenshot — I'll upload the image and confirm tomorrow.
- Billing behavior: Monica confirmed with finance that legacy SKUs accepted for 60 days for billing reconciliation; multi-entity purchases will require a single nominated merchant account per invoice, which CloudResell will need to support in their billing UI or we will split invoices (edge case note added).
- DocuSign: Ben created the envelope and it's sent to alice@cloudresell.com (status: sent). Ben — pls escalate if not signed in 48 hours.

Next steps and owners:
- Alice / CloudResell: sign DocuSign and confirm ingestion tests complete (owner: Alice) — target: Mon 2026-04-12.
- Ben: confirm DocuSign completion and send final mapping to AWS ops 10 business days prior to go-live (owner: Ben) — target: 2026-04-22.
- Laura: upload listing screenshot and merchant docs to our publisher portal (owner: Laura) — target: 2026-04-10.
- Monica: provide final billing exception doc to CloudResell (owner: Monica) — target: 2026-04-11.

If AWS or CloudResell ops sees any showstoppers, please flag on this thread and we'll convene a short ops call.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Partner Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
